description:
## Background

React Doctor reports `quality.ignores.ts`, `wdio.issue-list.conf.ts`, and `wdio.mermaid.conf.ts` as unreachable files. All three are live, but they sit outside the renderer's static module graph: the quality policy is imported by root lint/format configuration, and the WDIO files are loaded by command-line scenario harnesses.

React Doctor's dead-code phase consumes Knip-compatible `entry` configuration. Exact repository entry declarations can teach it about these command/config roots without ignoring source or adding fake imports.

## What to build

Describe the repository's non-bundled TypeScript entrypoints so dead-code analysis starts from every real command and configuration root and stops misclassifying these three files.

## Technical Approach

- Add a focused Knip-compatible `entry` configuration, using `knip.json` or the documented `package.json#knip` shape.
- Include the exact quality configuration roots needed to reach `quality.ignores.ts`.
- Include the exact Issue List and Mermaid WDIO configuration roots invoked by their scenario harnesses.
- Include other equivalent existing root entrypoints only when repository command evidence proves they are loaded the same way.
- Validate that the new roots remove the three false unused-file findings without hiding genuinely dead renderer modules.

## Considerations

- Do not add fake imports whose only purpose is satisfying the analyzer.
- Do not add broad ignore patterns for root TypeScript files.
- Knip does not need to become a new dependency merely for React Doctor to read its JSON entry shape.
- Dynamically loaded WDIO packages, Oxlint plugins, and CLI binaries may remain false unused-dependency findings because React Doctor currently consumes entry/ignore patterns but not dependency allowlists. Record those as analyzer limitations rather than weakening runtime configuration.
- This issue must not decide whether `tauri-agent-tools` is intentionally retained; that dependency still needs human workflow clarification.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Dead-code analysis models every declared entrypoint from a real repository command or configuration loader.
- [ ] `quality.ignores.ts`, `wdio.issue-list.conf.ts`, and `wdio.mermaid.conf.ts` are no longer reported as unused files.
- [ ] No broad ignore or synthetic import hides dead source.
- [ ] The configuration documents why non-bundled entrypoints are needed.
- [ ] React Doctor and the canonical repository verification complete successfully.

## Test Plan

- Run `mise run doctor:react` and confirm the three unused-file diagnostics are absent.
- Check the full diagnostic output for newly hidden or newly unreachable files.
- Run `mise run verify`.
- No application unit or desktop E2E test is required because runtime entrypoints are unchanged.

## Triage

ready-for-agent
title: Model non-bundled tooling entrypoints for dead-code analysis
